Clean working tree, `node_modules` properly gitignored. Both PRs are up.

## Summary

**PROJEXA PR #53** (https://github.com/FChecklist/projexa/pull/53): Extended `memberships.role` to `owner|admin|pm|site_engineer|member|client_viewer` (migration applied live via Supabase MCP), added `requireRole()`/`ROLE_GROUPS` to `auth-guard.ts`, and gated 6 real routes (budgets/schedule-baselines/change-orders/purchase-orders → PM-or-above; site-diary/punch-list → field roles incl. site_engineer). 6 new unit tests pass, `tsc` clean, security advisors unchanged.

**compliance-tracker PR #597** (https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/597): Extended `designerTimesheetReport()` with a real Category/Designer/Project/Designer-status Budget-vs-Actual breakdown, reusing `pms-budget-service.ts`'s existing budget-vs-actual pattern (not the ERP-based one, which investigation showed has no per-designer/category dimension). 6 new tests pass, full suite 2125/2125, `tsc` clean.

One pre-existing, unrelated issue noted but not fixed (per "avoid unrelated changes"): PROJEXA's repo-wide `bun test` fails on ~21 Playwright e2e specs due to a missing `bunfig.toml` test-root scope — confirmed present before my changes too; flagged in the PR description as a follow-up.

Both PRs are pushed and awaiting their normal review/merge pipeline. PROGRESS.md is up to date.
